subject: Stelaris SIG: precall - network logs retention and roles
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Maggie Chen <maggie.chen@stelaris.health>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Stelaris SIG: precall - network logs retention and roles

Hi Maggie —

Thanks for booking time for our SIG intake on Thursday. A quick precall so we come prepared: could you confirm the retention window you need for network flow logs and whether you want sampling of egress-only traffic? Typical asks we see are 90/180/365 days and a small sample (1-5%) for high-throughput flows.

From our side, Vivek will own the log export deliverables and Kimberly will be the SOC2 evidence contact. I’ll be the intake lead and will run the walkthrough.

To make Thursday efficient, I’ve attached a short README with the sample log formats we can provide and a network diagram we’ll share during the call. Could you also share any specific IP ranges or endpoints you want samples from, and whether you need anonymized user identifiers in the logs?

Proposed agenda (15 mins):
- 5m: quick intros + scope
- 5m: log types & retention (what Redwood can provide)
- 3m: evidence handoff and timelines
- 2m: next steps / action items

Appreciate if you can respond here or we can cover on the call.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: soc2-log-sample-README.txt (text)
Attachment: redwood-network-diagram-20261112.png (image)
From: Maggie Chen <maggie.chen@stelaris.health>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Stelaris Security Team <security@stelaris.health>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:48:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Stelaris SIG: precall - network logs retention and roles

Hi Olga —

Thanks — confirmed for Thursday at 10:30am ET. For retention, Stelaris baseline is 365 days for flow logs for production systems; for non-prod we usually ask for 90 days. For the intake we’d like samples from the production pool only (app-hosted traffic to our API gateways).

We prefer redaction of user identifiers (hashing) in samples. IP ranges: 52.23.0.0/16 and 34.120.0.0/14 are in scope — I’ll attach a small CSV to the calendar invite.

Also, does Redwood provide time-synced NTP markers in logs (UTC) or do we need to map?

Best,
Maggie Chen
Sr. Information Security Engineer
Stelaris Health
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Stelaris SIG: precall - network logs retention and roles

Kim / Vivek — forwarding Stelaris’ responses. Key asks: 365d retention for prod flow logs, 90d for non-prod, sample only prod pool, IP ranges included, and hashed user IDs in samples. Also they asked about NTP/UTC markers.

Vivek: can you confirm whether the default export includes UTC timestamps and whether we can produce a hashed-identifier view for samples? If hashing is not available server-side, what’s the recommended sanitize step (we may need to provide a script or a redacted sample).

Kim: once Vivek confirms the artifact names and retention policy, can you schedule the evidence handoff (DocuSign or secure transfer) and list which artifacts we’ll provide for SOC2 (flow log index, retention policy doc, sample CSV, network diagram)? They may want signed attestations.

I’ll be on the call with them tomorrow.

—Olga
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Stelaris SIG: precall - network logs retention and roles

Olga / Kim —

Confirmed: our flow logs include UTC timestamps (ISO8601) by default and include a sequence timestamp field we surface in exports. We can generate a hashed user identifier column for samples using a salted SHA256 hash at export time — I’ll create the export pipeline to produce the redacted CSV. Retention windows are configurable per-project; I’ll set the prod pool to 365d and non-prod to 90d for the buckets in scope and provide the retention policy JSON and an example export.

Artifacts I’ll prepare:
- flow_logs_prod_sample_20261112.csv (hashed IDs)
- flow_logs_schema.md
- retention_policy_prod.json
- export_instructions.sh (how we generated sample)

I’ll upload to the secure Drive folder ahead of the call.

Vivek
Principal Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Maggie Chen <maggie.chen@stelaris.health>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Stelaris Security Team <security@stelaris.health>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Post-call notes: flow logs, retention, and next steps

Hi Maggie / team —

Thanks for the call earlier. Quick notes and agreed actions:

Summary:
- Redwood provides ISO8601 UTC timestamps in all exports; sequence timestamp included.
- Production flow logs retention for the project: 365 days; non-prod: 90 days.
- We will provide hashed user identifiers in the sample CSV (salted SHA256).

Artifacts to be delivered (links sent to secure Drive):
- flow_logs_prod_sample_20261112.csv (attachment stub in this thread)
- flow_logs_schema.md
- retention_policy_prod.json
- redwood-network-diagram-20261112.png
- soc2-log-sample-README.txt

Action owners / deadlines:
- Vivek: upload artifacts to secure Drive and signal when permissions are set (by 2026-11-13 EOD).
- Kimberly: prepare SOC2 evidence packet and provide transfer instructions for signed artifacts (DocuSign or SFTP) (by 2026-11-16).
- Maggie: confirm receipt and whether hashed identifiers meet Stelaris requirements (by 2026-11-17).

Open questions:
- Maggie asked about proving retention enforcement (audit log). We will include a retention change audit log excerpt if required.

If anything is missing, flag it here and we’ll follow up.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: flow_logs_prod_sample_20261112.csv (stub), retention_policy_prod.json (stub)
